description: User story under REQ-191 for the separation verb (FBS-222). Range from the merge-base with origin/main to HEAD, merge commits skipped, Hand: trailer over the five estate hands, default path classes at any depth, one quotable line and --json rows.
asA: a gate reviewer reading a build pull request
iWant: one line that says whether any commit crossed hands
soThat: I quote it instead of re-reading every diff

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a branch whose commits are a Hand: test-author commit touching test/x.test.js and rcf/user-stories/us-1.json, a Hand: builder commit touching src/x.js and rcf/code-nodes/cn-1.json, and a Hand: verifier commit touching rcf/verify-reports/FBS-1/abc.json, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0 and prints "separation: PASS 3 commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): test-author 1, builder 1, verifier 1, stage-keeper 0, neutral 0, undeclared 0, exceptions 0".

[failure] Given a Hand: builder commit that touches test/x.test.js, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 and prints "separation: FAIL 1 of <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): <sha7> Hand=builder touches test/x.test.js"; the same holds for a Hand: test-author commit touching src/, and for a Hand: builder commit touching rcf/user-stories/.

[edge] Given an undeclared commit touching only src/ and another touching only test/, when the verb runs, then both pass and are counted under undeclared; an undeclared commit touching both src/ and test/ fails exit 4 naming both paths.

[failure] Given --base naming a ref that does not exist, the verb exits 2 with "separation: bad ref <ref>"; run outside a git repository it exits 1 with "separation: not a git repository"; a Hand: value outside the five hands and mixed is reported as a violation with reason "unknown hand <value>".

[happy] Given the same branch as the PASS case, when rcf audit separation --json runs, then stdout is a JSON array with one SeparationRow per non-merge commit { sha, subject, hand, declared, classes, verdict, reason, paths } and merge commits in the range are absent.

title: rcf audit separation judges each commit's hand against the paths it touches
